meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: Assists in writing high-quality content by conducting research, adding citations, improving hooks, iterating on outlines, and providing real-time feedback on each section. Transforms your writing process from solo effort to collaborative partnership.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 研究、引用、优化开头，协作迭代每段内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要高效完成有深度的文章或报告
copy.tagline_en: Research, cite, improve hooks, and iterate outlines collaboratively
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce in-depth articles or reports efficiently

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会作为写作伙伴，帮你研究、列提纲、写草稿、改进开头、逐段反馈，并保持你的个人风格。
howto.when: 当你开始写博客、文章、教程或案例研究，需要研究、引用或改进内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这篇文章列一个提纲。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成提纲。

say.text: 帮我改进这段开头，让它更吸引人。
say.note: Claude 会分析并提供多个改进选项。

say.text: 我刚写完“为什么重要”这一节，请给反馈。
say.note: Claude 会逐段审查并提供具体建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a writing partner to help you research, outline, draft, and refine content while maintaining your unique voice and style.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you start writing blog posts, articles, tutorials, or case studies and need research, citations, or content improvement.

say_en.text: Help me create an outline for this article.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through outlining.

say_en.text: Help me improve this hook to make it more compelling.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and suggest alternatives.

say_en.text: I just finished the 'Why This Matters' section. Review it and give feedback.
